scenario.quote: Name: Return clothes from bathroom floor to hamper

other.Name: Return clothes from bathroom floor to hamper

objects.name: clothes
objects.role: clothing items to be gathered and placed into the hamper

starting_state.fact: 1–3 clothing items (towels, shirts, socks) are present.
Clothing items are located on the floor or draped behind the door in random positions.
starting_state.quote: Position: On the floor or draped behind the door in random positions.

steps.text: Walk to the clothes and stand still for 1 second.
steps.quote: Walk to the clothes and stand still for 1 second.

steps.text: Start with arms in a neutral position. Pick up 1–2 items with one hand using a full-palm grasp.
steps.quote: Start with arms in a neutral position. Pick up 1–2 items with one hand using a full-palm grasp.

steps.text: Walk to the hamper and stop for 1 second.
steps.quote: Walk to the hamper and stop for 1 second.

steps.text: Hold items over the hamper opening and release them inside.
steps.quote: Hold items over the hamper opening and release them inside.

repeat.end_condition: All clothing items are in the hamper.
repeat.quote: Pick up 1–2 items with one hand using a full-palm grasp.

acceptance.criterion: The items are released inside the hamper.

constraints.rule: No wet or soiled items may be handled.
constraints.violation_looks_like: A person handles or collects an item that is wet or visibly stained/soiled.
Clothes are forced into an already full hamper or are overflowing above the rim.

constraints.rule: Do not drag items on the floor.
constraints.violation_looks_like: A piece of clothing contacts the floor and is pulled along the surface while being moved.
constraints.quote: Do not drag items on floor.

constraints.rule: Start the pick-up action with arms in a neutral position.
constraints.violation_looks_like: The person begins the reach with arms pre-raised, bent, or not resting neutrally.
constraints.quote: Start with arms in a neutral position.

constraints.rule: Pick up items using one hand with a full-palm grasp.
constraints.violation_looks_like: The person uses two hands or holds the clothing using only fingertips or a pinch grip.
constraints.quote: with one hand using a full-palm grasp

not_modelled.quote: Reset: Randomize positions and item types each episode.

not_modelled.reason: Dataset collection diversity instruction regarding item types.
